name: dburl
description: Package dburl provides a standard, URL style mechanism for parsing and opening SQL database connection strings

latest_release.name: v0.58.0
latest_release.body: Moves the `hive` and `impala` schemes to the dbimp driver `github.com/xo/dbimp/hive`. Both write `hive://user:password@host:port/database?httpPath=...`. The `auth=NONE` and `default` database defaults are gone, and `impala` adds port 28000. Provisional until dbimp tags the driver (D74).
